items.prompt: A covariance estimate fails Cholesky. What would you check before adding a small diagonal?
items.modelAnswer: Check symmetry, complete aligned rows, units/scale, rank/collinearity, numerical tolerance and conditioning, and whether the estimator should be PD at all. Any jitter/shrinkage changes the model and needs a stated reason, magnitude and impact assessment.

criteria.text: Does not silently treat a changed covariance as the original.
